taxable_object: digital services supplied by foreign registered person to consumer in Malaysia
liable_node: foreign service provider; guidance includes qualifying online-platform operators
destination_evidence: consumer satisfies any two of Malaysian payment facility; Malaysian IP/mobile country code; Malaysian residence
transaction_rail: registration above RM500000 threshold; service tax due when payment received unless invoice basis approved; quarterly taxable period
reconciliation_power: not yet frozen as a comparable country-level variable
open_issue: freeze current legal basis for platform-liability edge cases and reconciliation/audit powers

taxable_object: utilization in Indonesia of covered intangible taxable goods and/or taxable services supplied from outside customs area through PMSE
liable_node: DGT-designated PMSE VAT collector including foreign merchant/service provider/digital platform and domestic digital platform
destination_evidence: Indonesian user/transaction nexus is built into PMSE appointment and taxable utilization; exact destination-evidence rule requires separate freeze
transaction_rail: collector charges VAT; issues commercial invoice/billing/order receipt; remits and reports through DGT systems
reconciliation_power: DGT appointment list and recurring returns create an auditable remitter population; exact reconciliation powers require legal-source freeze
open_issue: resolve procedural conflict between current DGT page and older portal copy on return frequency before manuscript wording

taxable_object: covered sales of goods/services by household and individual sellers on e-commerce/digital platforms
liable_node: platform manager with payment function within Decree 117 scope
destination_evidence: seller identity and transaction information required; destination is not the primary comparative mechanism in this case
transaction_rail: withhold declare and pay on behalf at successful transaction confirmation/payment acceptance; tax percentage applied to revenue of each transaction
reconciliation_power: platform-level transaction reporting and remittance are established; broader audit/reconciliation powers require source freeze
open_issue: use 2025-07-01 operative date; check interaction with later 2026 implementing tax rules before final freeze

taxable_object: covered electronic services supplied from abroad to non-VAT-registered customers in Thailand
liable_node: foreign electronic-service operator or electronic platform meeting threshold; guidance assigns platform liability when it controls continuous offer/payment/delivery process
destination_evidence: service supplied to and used by customer in Thailand; exact evidentiary tests require source freeze
transaction_rail: VES registration and filing portal; platform/operator VAT remittance above THB1.8M annual threshold
reconciliation_power: dedicated nonresident portal and filing obligations established; exact reconciliation/audit powers require source freeze
open_issue: freeze governing-law provisions alongside FAQ before strong platform-liability wording

taxable_object: digital services consumed or used in the Philippines
liable_node: nonresident digital service provider for B2C; Philippine buyer/withholding agent for covered B2B; resident e-marketplace for specified payments
destination_evidence: payment information; residence information; access information; other reliable evidence; at least two non-conflicting pieces if contradictory
transaction_rail: NRDSP registration through VDS portal; direct VAT remittance for covered B2C; final withholding VAT for covered B2B/marketplace paths
reconciliation_power: BIR registration filing payment and withholding codes create multiple auditable rails; exact enforcement/reconciliation powers require source freeze
open_issue: separate B2C NRDSP duties B2B buyer withholding and marketplace withholding in manuscript rather than collapsing them
